settings.title: Settings
settings.mediaTailHelp: When a question’s sound or video lasts longer than its timer, the question is stretched to the end of the media plus this pause: nothing is cut mid-play.
settings.loudnessHelp: The level every sound and video of the quiz is brought to at playback, so the volume stays the same from one question to the next. The files are not changed.
settings.audioTargetHelp: Which devices play the sounds and videos of the quiz. Participants in the room see the projection: their phones stay silent unless "Every device" is chosen, which echoes if they share a room. A question can choose otherwise, and the host can change it for a session.

broadcast.title: Broadcast
broadcast.fullCaptureHelp: Keeps each player's answer details (individual tracking). Enable before presenting.
broadcast.archiveHelp: An archived quiz leaves the main list; it can be restored.
broadcast.fullCaptureNext: Full answer capture for the next session

feedback.enableHelp: A rating panel is offered at the end of every session.
feedback.title: Player feedback

tone.light: Light text on a darkened image
tone.dark: Dark text on a lightened image

slideForm.displayHint: In manual mode the host always moves on by hand.
slideForm.invalidError: A slide needs a title, some content or a media.

emptyPane.emptyHint: Start with a question, or with an intro slide.
emptyPane.selectHint: Pick an item in the list to edit it.

deleteConfirm.hint: Delete this quiz and all its history.
deleteConfirm.title: Delete this quiz?
deleteConfirm.description: “{{title}}” and its questions will be permanently deleted. This action cannot be undone.

questionForm.answerExplanationPlaceholder: Why this is the right answer… (optional)
questionForm.revealDelayHint: In automatic mode: time spent on the answer before the next question. Empty = default setting.
questionForm.audioTargetHint: Which devices play this question's sound or video. "Every device" includes the phones in the room, which echo if they share it.
questionForm.waveformSizeHint: How thick the sound's waveform is drawn on the projection and the phones.

scoringHelp.multiple_choice: Partial credit: each right tick earns its share, each wrong tick cancels one.
scoringHelp.ordering: Partial credit: share of the elements at the right position.
scoringHelp.text_input: Tolerate typos: one edit up to 5 letters, two beyond (after case/accent normalisation).
scoringHelp.numeric: Closest answer wins: scored at the reveal — exact (within tolerance) = full points, then 75 / 50 / 30 %, 10 % beyond; no speed bonus.

removeOptionConfirm.title: Remove this option?
removeOptionConfirm.description: “{{label}}” will be removed from the question.

questionForm.stretchedTime: The media lasts {{media}} s: the question will last {{total}} s (end of the media + the quiz’s {{tail}} s pause).
questionForm.listenFirstLabel: Start the timer when the media ends
questionForm.listenFirstHint: Listen first, then answer: nobody can answer while the sound or video plays, and everyone gets the full time to think afterwards.
questionForm.listenFirstTime: The media plays {{media}} s, then the {{time}} s of answering start.

preview.noQuestions: This quiz has no questions yet.

media.demoDisabled: Media uploads are disabled on the demo instance.
media.altPlaceholder: e.g. Kylian Mbappé in a France shirt
media.altHelp: Read aloud by screen readers. Describe what the image shows when it carries part of the question; leave it empty when the image is decoration.
media.videoExcludesAudio: The video already has its own sound: no extra audio track. Remove the video to add a sound.
media.audioExcludesVideo: A video already has its own sound: remove the sound to choose a video.

notice.gifFirstFrame: Animated GIF: only its first frame is kept.

status.draft: Draft — publish the quiz to present it.
status.archived: Archived — restore it to edit or present it.

questionTypeHelp.single_choice: One correct answer among 2 to 8 options. Points scale with speed, plus a streak bonus.
questionTypeHelp.multiple_choice: Several correct answers; the participant ticks then submits. All or nothing: the ticked set must match exactly.
questionTypeHelp.true_false: Two fixed options, one correct. The fastest to play.
questionTypeHelp.text_input: The participant types the answer. Matched against the accepted answers ignoring case, accents and extra spaces.
questionTypeHelp.numeric: The participant enters a number; correct when within ± tolerance of the target.
questionTypeHelp.ordering: The participant sorts the options into the order set by the positions (#). All or nothing.
questionTypeHelp.poll: Opinion only: no correct answer, no points; the distribution is shown at the reveal.

sessions.liveEditsHint: Layout and presentation edits (backgrounds, contrast, explanations, slides) reach running sessions at their next step; questions and answers stay as launched.
